subject: MedInsight MAP: GCP private-offer onramp (sandbox -> PO)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Verma <sana.verma@medinsight.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedInsight MAP: GCP private-offer onramp (sandbox -> PO)

Hi Sana —

Great to meet yesterday. To keep momentum I put together a concise mutual action plan (MPA) so we’re aligned on the evaluation gates and procurement steps for a GCP private-offer purchase. Attached is a one-page MPA (MPA_medinsight_v1.pdf) and a short draft SOW we can iterate on.

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Day 0 (this week): Share MAP + access details for evaluation sandbox (owner: Redwood, action: sandbox invite)
- Day 3–10: Technical eval (MedInsight infra + perf tests) — share token budget & sample prompts (owner: MedInsight)
- Day 7–14: Security/compliance review — SOC2 artifacts + IaaS attestations (owner: MedInsight)
- Day 10–21: Private Offer creation on GCP Marketplace and pricing confirmation (owner: Redwood / GCP partner)
- Day 14–28: PO issuance and billing path setup (owner: MedInsight procurement)

Open questions for your procurement team so we can prepare:
1) Which legal entity should the invoice be issued to?
2) Is there an internal PO template or special billing contact we should loop in?
3) Any specific security artifacts beyond SOC2 (e.g., data flow diagrams) you need up front?

Ben — I’ve looped you for billing + marketplace flow.

Next steps: Sana — if the above dates look reasonable, can you confirm procurement contact and suggested PO window? If you prefer, we can do a 30-min handoff call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec — Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Sana Verma <sana.verma@medinsight.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medinsight.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedInsight MAP: GCP private-offer onramp (sandbox -> PO)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick notes from procurement and security:

- Procurement: Please invoice to MedInsight, Inc. (US entity). Procurement contact is procurement@medinsight.ai — they handle PO issuance and vendor setup. Typical lead time for private offers is 2–3 weeks once the pricing and SOW are signed.
- Security: We will need SOC2 Type II report and an architecture diagram showing where tokens/responses are processed. If Redwood can provide a redacted SOC2 plus an ATO checklist, that speeds review.

Two questions: 1) Does the GCP private-offer flow support invoice-based billing to our legal entity (vs. card)? 2) Who will own the Marketplace listing process — Redwood or your partner?

If possible, please provide the billing path and a short timeline for private-offer creation so procurement can slot us in. Happy to do the handoff call; procurement is available Thursday 9–11 PT.

—Sana
Sana Verma
VP Product — MedInsight
[sana.verma@medinsight.ai]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Verma <sana.verma@medinsight.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedInsight MAP: GCP private-offer onramp (sandbox -> PO)

Sana — quick answers and a recommended path.

1) Billing path: Redwood supports invoice-based billing for GCP private offers where the customer is billed via a reseller/partner arrangement. We typically stand up a private offer in GCP Marketplace tied to the customer’s legal entity and the partner manages invoice routing. Attached is a one-pager: gcp-private-offer-billing-path.pdf (diagram + steps).

2) Marketplace ownership: Redwood will coordinate with our partner (CloudBuy) to create the private-offer listing; CloudBuy will act as the billing/reseller layer to allow invoice billing to MedInsight, Inc. Alex Torres from CloudBuy is CC’d on this thread to confirm timing and any additional paperwork.

3) Documents we’ll provide within 48 hours: redacted SOC2 Type II, topology diagram, pricing breakout to embed in the private-offer.

Proposed MAP timeline (tight):
- Aug 7–9: Tech sandbox access + test prompts (owner: MedInsight)
- Aug 9–13: Security review (MedInsight) + SOC2 artifact delivery (Redwood)
- Aug 10–16: Private-offer creation w/ CloudBuy (Redwood + CloudBuy)
- Aug 16–21: Legal sign & DocuSign (MedInsight legal + Redwood legal)
- Aug 21–28: PO issued; billing account finalization (MedInsight procurement)

Links: HubSpot record — https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/MI-4331
DocuSign prep — https://www.docusign.com/prepare/rdw-mi-4331

Ben Carter
Head of Marketplace Sales — Redwood Inference
[ben_carter@redwood.ai]

Attachment stubs: gcp-private-offer-billing-path.pdf (diagram), SOC2_redacted.pdf (redacted, 12p)

Please send the SOW draft and final pricing; we can aim to issue PO by Aug 22 if paperwork is submitted by Aug 16.
